name: aspartate-residue-molecular
description: One aspartate at -1e, 12 atoms, on the shared surface: between `acetate-molecular`'s eight atoms and the peptide's twenty, which is the size range where a boundary-element mesher stops being able to answer. Measured: TABI-PB aborts on this one immediately, on `stoul: no conversion` *after* reporting the surface built, where acetate instead runs past its 600 s timeout. Same size class, two unrelated mechanisms, so neither is 'too small' as a rule.
